borough_rule: borough is the borough that eligibility is restricted to. If eligibility is not borough-restricted, it is the venue's borough. 'citywide' means eligibility is any NYC resident and the opportunity is not limited to one borough's residents. 'unknown' is used when the venue borough is not stated; such records cannot match a borough filter.
dedupe_key: normalized title | borough (or region when borough is null) | deadline.
verification: Every eligibility quote was matched verbatim against the fetched page text.

2026-11-02: 32 records from NYFA's Artist Opportunities board (nyfa.org/opportunities), each read from its own listing page. NYFA returns 403 to plain requests but its robots.txt allows crawling; the pages were read with a browser-style user agent at Mara's direction. 2026-11-02: 63 records from NYFA's job board (nyfa.org/jobs) and 27 from its studio and space classifieds (nyfa.org/spaces), each read from its own listing page with the same browser-style user agent used for the opportunities board, at Mara's direction. Of 240 jobs, 24 outside the covered regions and 8 already past their deadline were dropped. Jobs kept are hands-on creative or arts-sector roles (studio assistants, art handlers, preparators, fabricators, printers, framers, teaching artists and faculty, designers, curatorial and conservation fellowships, DJs, models); back-office roles (development, finance, HR, marketing, executive, gallery sales) were left out. NYC Parks returned 403 to plain requests; with Mara's go-ahead the events calendar (/events/arts, 107 list pages at 4-second intervals) and the five event pages were read with a browser-style user agent. robots.txt was checked: event pages are allowed, /*json and /*xml are not and were not requested. 2026-11-02: 8 more ArtsWestchester artist-opportunity listings (artswestchester.org/artist-opportunities, pages 1 and 2), each read from its own page with a plain request at 5-second intervals; no browser-style header was needed this time and the earlier Cloudflare challenge did not appear. robots.txt allows these pages; its Content-signal is search=yes, ai-train=no, and the pages were read only to build listing records. Quotes were matched verbatim. Three listings already past their deadline (a Mamaroneck Artists Guild membership and holiday market, Yellow Studio Small Works) were skipped. El Museo del Barrio (Cloudflare 'Just a moment' challenge), Brooklyn Museum (Vercel security checkpoint) and Entry Thingy (Cloudflare challenge) still block automated requests and were not read.

2026-11-02: all 311 Craigslist records were re-read one post at a time through the page-reading tool at Mara's request (no browser-style header; Craigslist robots.txt allows post pages and has no Claude-specific rule; its terms prohibit automated access, so this was a decision by Mara for this class project, to be disclosed to Jon). Each post's posted and updated dates were read from the page. known_gaps: Eventbrite and Meetup terms prohibit scraping; library calendars (NYPL, Queens) are JS-only or CAPTCHA-gated.
About 1,728 roster orgs have no discoverable website by domain guessing.
BRIC's full class catalog loads through a filter app; only the orientation is linked.
NYC Parks rate-limits crawlers; its records come from list-page microdata fetched at 4s intervals.
Fee is 'unknown' wherever the page does not state one.
NYC Parks event pages returned 403 to the crawler on 2026-10-28; 5 NYC Event Calendar candidates held.
Eventbrite's public event search was shut down in 2019; the API can only re-read known event IDs, so it is not used.
disciplines_field: Added 2026-10-27. Tags which practices a record is open to; 'all' means any discipline. Not a request filter in v1 (PRD inputs are borough and type); available to the Ranker.
region_field: Scope (2026-10-27): anywhere an NYC artist can reasonably reach - NY, NJ, CT, PA, MA, RI, VT, NH, ME, DE, MD, DC. 'nyc' records carry a borough; others have borough null. The PRD still lists non-NYC as a non-goal and needs updating.
scope_notes: 2026-10-27: scope widened to every creative discipline (open-ended), the NYC tri-state metro, and participatory events (jams, open mics, drum circles, drawing sessions, workshops, classes) plus paid performer and teaching gigs.
Recurring events use deadline 'recurring' with a recurrence string; dated events use the next date as deadline.

extraction values: manual (hand-built from fetched pages), structured (parsed from a listing site's fixed fields), api (WordPress events calendar API), crawl_reviewed (auto-extracted from the deep crawl, then individually reviewed).
extraction values added: jsonld (schema.org Event data), rendered (headless Chrome), auto_text (rule-based text extraction, lower confidence).
2026-10-28: added opportunity_type 'job' (salaried or hourly creative positions; pay in award) per the PRD update.

roster_discovery.source: NYC Open Data DCLA Cultural Organizations (u35m-9t32), 2,535 orgs
roster_discovery.method: domain guessing with homepage title match, robots-gated

compliance_notes: 2026-10-27: a Squarespace collector requested '?format=json' collection URLs after checking robots.txt for the page path only. Squarespace's default robots.txt disallows '/*?format=json', so these requests were disallowed on every site involved (including jalopytheatre.org, anbealbochtcafe.com, brooklynmusicschool.org, hudsonvalleymoca.org, kundiman.org, culturehub.org, and DCLA roster sites). All data from that endpoint was deleted. The two records first found that way (Hudson Valley MOCA Artist Club, An Beal Bocht Poor Mouth Writers' Night) were also found on robots-allowed event pages in the crawl and verified there, so they remain. The collector now checks the exact URL it requests.

2026-10-27: a full-URL robots audit of every record (75 hosts) found 2 on robots-disallowed pages (societyillustrators.org event pages, also disallowed for the events API query). Both records and all fetched data from that host were removed; the source is presentation-only. The verifier now checks robots.txt before fetching.
